! Tracking Parameter Stripping Rules ($removeparam)
||facebook.com^$removeparam=fbclid
||instagram.com^$removeparam=fbclid
||google.com^$removeparam=gclid
||google.com^$removeparam=gbraid
||google.com^$removeparam=wbraid
||bing.com^$removeparam=msclkid
||twitter.com^$removeparam=twclid
||tiktok.com^$removeparam=ttclid
||linkedin.com^$removeparam=trk
||linkedin.com^$removeparam=li_fat_id
||mailchimp.com^$removeparam=mc_eid
||yandex.com^$removeparam=yclid
||pinterest.com^$removeparam=epik
